output.reason: The evidence states that the “Levy of Foreclosure Charges/Pre-payment Penalty on Floating Rate Term Loans (2014)” direction/circular was withdrawn/repealed by the Reserve Bank of India (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025 with effect from 2026-01-01, and further notes that on 2026-11-23 it is no longer in force. This directly supports the claim that the older floating-rate foreclosure-charge direction was withdrawn and not in force on 2026-11-23.
